text: I'll review the full P8.8 diff against the standalone contract, reading the plan sections and the changed scripts and tests for isolation, false greens, and weakened checks.
thought:
Beginning the final independent read-only review of P8.8.

Reviewing the P8.8 implementation against its contract. The root script `scripts/skiller-standalone-check.sh` copies tracked Skiller and core files to a temporary layout while excluding `.git/packages/host-config`, then runs `test.sh` and `validate.sh`. The CI job `skiller-standalone` in `test.yml` is also being verified.

Tests failing outside the monorepo are fixed with temporary host-config, a tmp git init, or an explicit skip rather than by removing the check. PYTHONPATH and SKILLER_HOST_CONFIG are reset before execution. Only git-tracked files are copied. Skiller scripts remain unaware of the standalone check because it lives at the root. The implementation is stdlib-only with English diagnostics and texts; core is permitted under D20. Three root provider data catalogs must be recorded alongside tracked core and package files.
